_comment: Rows of the generic Excel template (GET /api/brdp-template.xlsx) for a standard with no curated template (S1000D 5.0/6.0). Same content the frontend generateTemplate() built from src/data/mockBRDPs.js: Rule Status To Do and an empty Rule on every row -- the only combination valid in any project.

rows.title: Use of "I" and "O"
rows.definition: Decide whether and when to use the alpha characters "I" and "O".
rows.proposal: The use of alpha  characters "I" and "O" in S1000D data shall be compliant with ATA iSpec 2200, Specification 2000, and the CSDD.

rows.title: List of permitted CAGE codes and/or names to be used for the technical publication project
rows.definition: Create a list of permitted CAGE codes and/or names of the enterprises.
rows.proposal: XXXXX is permitted as CAGE code in this project.

rows.title: Issue of S1000D to be used
rows.definition: Decide which issue or issues of S1000D to be used.

rows.title: Information sets to be used
rows.definition: Decide which information sets, given in S1000D and/or project specific, to be used.

rows.title: Publications to be produced
rows.definition: Decide which publications to be produced.
rows.proposal:
One CMP per LRU (=project) as XML delivery package
Installation Publication per customer listing the specifics of the component installation allowed.
PDF export optional.

rows.title: Schemas to be used
rows.definition: Decide which Schemas to be used and in which information set they are to be used.
rows.proposal: Descriptive, Procedural and IPD schemas shall be used as per Writing Style Guide

rows.title: Use of optional elements and attributes
rows.definition: Decide whether and how to use each optional element and attribute in its structural context.
rows.proposal: Refer to Section 2-3 for General Civil Aviation rules for element and attribute usage.

rows.title: Possible deliverables
rows.definition:
Decide on the possible deliverables, such as: 
S1000D objects (eg, data modules, publication modules, illustration sheets and multimedia objects, data management lists) using file based transfer. Refer to Chap 7.5.1.
Page-oriented publications and/or interactive electronic technical publications
rows.proposal: As per Spec 1000BR Section 3-2-3, LHT expects and sends a Transfer Package including DDN , PM, Content DM, ACT, CIR Enterprise and ICN when referenced within a DM. PDF export optional.

rows.title: Frequency of data exchanges
rows.definition: Decide on the frequency of data exchanges.

rows.title: Zone and access point identification system
rows.definition: Decide whether to use a zoning and access identification system.
rows.proposal: Zoning rules shall not be applied for CMPs
